front.title: Verification Promotion and Agent Assurance Appraisal Profile

abstract.t: This document maps protocol-verification evidence and the WIVL assurance-stage model onto the RATS architecture. It defines appraisal requirements for SPEC_VALIDATED, LOCAL_CONFORMANT, INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED, and SECURITY_TESTED results while preserving unknown evidence and requiring arithmetic preconditions for mathematical test vectors. An attestation result reports bounded assurance; it is not an authorization grant or production-release decision.
